leaves.name: deRhamVpAbVarPrinted
leaves.doc: Fontaine: the Tate module V_p(A) of an abelian variety over a finite extension of Q_p is de Rham, D_dR(V) = (B_dR (x) V)^{G_F} (printed form; Berger 2004 I.3 records it, wording read by h-leaves; Fontaine Ann. of Math. 115 (1982) / LNM 1016 (1983) numbers UNVERIFIED); Berger's B_dR = B_dR^+[1/t] matched by DeRhamPrint.TDict.bdREquivAwayT
leaves.source: V_p(A) de Rham, printed D_dR (Berger 2004 I.3, attributing it to Fontaine; Faltings 1989 / Tsuji 1999 give it for H^1_et = V_p(A)^dual); B_dR^+[1/t] = kernel B_dR proved (derham-print)
